text: I slipped and fell in a shopping centre in Brisbane. Which public liability lawyers are best?

result.keyword: I slipped and fell in a shopping centre in Brisbane. Which public liability lawyers are best?

items.markdown:
`Several established national and Queensland-wide personal injury law firms` handle public liability claims in Brisbane, commonly operating on a **No Win, No Fee** basis.[[1]](https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/injury-illness/public-place-injury/slip-and-fall-lawyers-brisbane/)[[2]](https://www.shine.com.au/service/personal-injury-lawyers-qld/public-liability-qld)[[3]](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/personal-injury/public-liability)

When looking for representation for a shopping centre slip and fall, consider prominent firms with dedicated Brisbane offices and experience in retail occupier liability:

- **Maurice Blackburn** – Operates a large [Brisbane public place injury team](https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/injury-illness/public-place-injury/slip-and-fall-lawyers-brisbane/) handling slip, trip, and fall claims across South East Queensland.
- **Shine Lawyers** – A major Queensland-founded firm providing [public liability and personal injury services](https://www.shine.com.au/service/personal-injury-lawyers-qld/public-liability-qld) statewide for injuries occurring in public and retail spaces.[[1]](https://www.shine.com.au/service/personal-injury-lawyers-qld/public-liability-qld)
- **Slater and Gordon** – Offers [public liability legal services](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/personal-injury/public-liability) handling third-party negligence, property hazard disputes, and compensation claims.[[1]](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/personal-injury/public-liability)
- **Gerard Malouf & Partners (GMP Law)** – Specialises in [Brisbane public liability claims](https://www.gerardmaloufpartners.com.au/public-liability-lawyers/brisbane/) specifically involving shopping centre, supermarket, and retail premise hazards.[[1]](https://www.gerardmaloufpartners.com.au/public-liability-lawyers/brisbane/)

### Key Steps and Time Limits in Queensland

- **Time Limits:** In Queensland, you generally have **3 years** from the date of the injury to file a formal claim, but strict preliminary notice periods apply much earlier under the *Personal Injuries Proceedings Act 2002*.[[1]](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/personal-injury/public-liability)
- **No Win, No Fee:** Most reputable firms offer an initial free consultation and operate on a conditional cost agreement, meaning legal fees are only paid if your claim is successful.[[1]](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/personal-injury/public-liability)[[2]](https://www.shine.com.au/service/personal-injury-lawyers-qld/public-liability-qld)

If you want to narrow down your options, let me know:

- **How severe** your injuries are
- **If you reported** the incident to shopping centre management
- Whether you have **photos or witness details** from the scene

I can help outline what information to prepare for an initial lawyer consultation.
